mapper.select: with total_amt as ( select sum(a.amount + COALESCE(b.total_amount, 0)) as budget_total ,sum(COALESCE(b.total_amount, 0)) as exec_total from tb_budget_category a left outer join ( select budget_id ,sum(total_amount) as total_amount from tb_expense_resolutions group by budget_id ) b on a.code = b.budget_id ) select budget_total ,exec_total ,round((exec_total/budget_total)*100, 1) as rate from total_amt

with calc as ( select a.dept_id ,a.budget_id ,b.dept_name ,sum(a.total_amount + c.amount) as amount ,sum(a.total_amount) as exec_amount ,sum(c.amount) as remain_amount from tb_expense_resolutions a left outer join tb_dept b on a.dept_id = b.dept_code inner join tb_budget_category c on a.budget_id = c.code group by a.dept_id, a.budget_id, b.dept_name ) select dept_id, budget_id, dept_name, amount, exec_amount, remain_amount from calc
